messages:
elaine: Quick alert  trying to cut the sample-app SDK but `yarn typegen` produced a regen diff that changed TS overload ordering. Local smoke tests fail. Repro: `git checkout release && yarn && yarn typegen && git --no-pager diff`
rob: Paste the minimal diff?
elaine: small example:
```diff
- call(ids: string[], opts?: {timeout?: number, retry?: boolean})
+ call(ids: string[], retry?: boolean, opts?: {timeout?: number})
```
mike: That's a positional break for callers using positional args. Did openapi.yaml change?
elaine: No schema change. Looks like typegen v0.12.3 re-grouped optional params.
li: Our changelog bot labeled the release as patch because only a docstring changed in the source repo. Mismatch between semver inference and actual signature diffs.
regen-bot: Auto PR created by @elaine: "typegen: keep original param tuple order to avoid positional breaks" (PR #4999)
rob: Plan: block the SDK publish for sample-app, revert the published artifacts if already pushed, and hold the release until fixed. Add a manual changelog review label to prevent autopatch.
mike: I'll add a deterministic unit test in typegen asserting stable overload ordering when multiple optional groups are present. Also adding a regen-diff CI check to fail if signature ordering flips without an OpenAPI schema change.
li: I'll update changelog-bot rules so signature diffs require human review ("semver-impact: review"). Also file a short postmortem if we end up reverting.
elaine: Revert PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/p/sample-apps/pulls/501  tagging @li for release decision.
rob: Once 0.12.4 patch with ordering fix is published and smoke tests are green, we can re-run the release checklist.
elaine: Action items captured: 1) revert publish & hold release, 2) patch typegen + unit test, 3) regen-diff CI check, 4) changelog-bot rule update, 5) postmortem if revert needed.
li: ACK. Will coordinate with release ops.
mike: Reproducer gist: https://gist.github.com/mike/regen-repro  includes the openapi fragment and local typegen output.
elaine: Will close loop once smoke green and changelog corrected. :thumbsup:
